primarySourceAssessment.scope: Published XNU xnu-11417.101.15 supplies a mechanism consistent with these observations, not proof of the exact running kernel path or this candidate cause.

sources.supports: The public BSD flags define PROC_FLAG_INEXIT=4 as an exit-in-progress indicator.
BSD info derives INEXIT from P_LEXIT.
The BSD(arg1) path can use a zombie reference when ordinary proc_find fails; taskallinfo(arg0) cannot use that fallback.
Exit preparation moves the process to the zombie list and marks its reference dead before a later proc_exit assignment of SZOMB. Cleanup between those points may block.

primarySourceAssessment.inference: A transition can therefore be consistent with BSD non-zombie metadata and task ESRCH. INEXIT was not recorded in this trial, so no retrospective attribution is justified.
primarySourceAssessment.lineAnchors: Independently verified from immutable-tag provider raw source bytes.
